messages:
Ellen: Thanks for joining the all-hands — opening a short thread for the unanswered Qs and the action checklist. Recording + slides: https://redwood.ai/allhands/apr-2026 :triangular_flag_on_post:
Ravi: Can you confirm GA stability targets? Specifically p95 latency and acceptable error budget. Need to sync with sales deck.
Ellen: p95 target = 180ms for small models, 250ms for large at nominal load. Error budget TBD by Ben in Legal/product. We'll lock numbers by Fri.
Sofia: Is there a dependency matrix for GA features vs. docs? e.g., RBAC + audit logs must ship for Private GA.
Jorge: Yep — RBAC and audit logs are blockers for Private GA. I'm coordinating with eng-security; ETA for audit pipeline fix is next Tue.
Nina: For Dedicated, customers asked about capacity burst limits. Are we exposing a per-customer burst toggle?
Ellen: Not on day 1. We have autoscale policies with soft limits; adding explicit burst UI is a follow-on. Owner for roadmap item: @Ravi.
Ravi: I'll add a ticket and priority it for Q3.
Sofia: Docs ask: short "what to expect on day 0" doc for customers (limits, perf caveats, upgrade path). I can draft one if folks ok.
Ellen: Please do — target 1-pager. Put it in the docs repo and drop link here. Owner: @Sofia (EOW).
ops-bot: Incident watch: Canary cluster provisioned in us-west-2 at 2026-04-12T15:03:00Z. Monitoring hooks attached.
Jorge: I'll run the canary checklist during the first 24h and post a health snapshot.
Nina: Support asked for a quick "troubleshooting" cheat sheet: KV cache warmup, tokenization edge cases, model fallback logic. Can we include in the 1-pager?
Sofia: Yes, adding a Troubleshooting section. Short bullet points only.
Ellen: Action summary (compact):
- @Jorge: finish audit pipeline fix + canary health snapshot (next Tue + during canary)
- @Sofia: 1-pager "day 0" + troubleshooting (EOW)
- @Ravi: ticket for Dedicated burst UI (Q3) + finalize burst messaging for sales (next Wed)
- Legal/product: finalize error budget and SLA numbers (Fri)
I'll post a follow-up status message on Thursday. If anyone picks up extra work, please @mention me here so I can update owners. :sparkles:
Ravi: small note 12 — sales wants a one-line summary we can use in outbound emails. Can we have something like: "Redwood Dedicated: predictable capacity, auto-failover, and low-latency inference at scale." Thoughts?
Ellen: Good start — tweak to call out "data isolation" for enterprise buyers.
Sofia: Drafted line: "Redwood Dedicated delivers predictable capacity, data isolation, and low-latency inference with enterprise-grade controls." Approve?
Jorge: Approve from infra side.
Nina: Approve from support.
Ellen: Approved. We'll hand to marketing after Ben signs off on the SLA phrasing.
ops-bot: Reminder: post-mortem template updated in #incidents.
